name: stage5d_passkey_stream_alibi
description: Position-free passkey protocol (data.passkey.insert_passkey_stream): each 512-byte training window contains a passkey with probability 0.5; STORE uniform over the window; RECALL 16-448 bytes later, truncated at the window end. Fixed budget of 10,000 steps x 16 x 512 bytes (81.9M bytes), no early stopping; 3 seeds. Recall is evaluated inside the training length (gaps 64-512) before extrapolation (up to 16K).
